modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline

dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done by interpreting the assembly drawing/work instructions/SOPs
select the appropriate method of assembly on the basis of drawing information
identify the tools, measuring instruments, equipment, auto components/parts and sub- assemblies required for the job
check and clean the assembling equipment of any dust and impurities
fill CLRI (Clean, lubricate, retighten & inspection) check sheet and report to the supervisor about any abnormalities identified and action taken to resolve them
setup the equipment required as per the selected assembling method
ensure that the right programme is selected in case of robotic assembly method as defined in the SOP
lift the auto component manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the designated slot/space as indicated in the drawing/work instructions
inspect and mark the defects if any, such as in paint, dents, grooves, cracks, rough edges etc. on the physical body of the auto component
check all the semi-precision mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic and electrical parts in the auto components by using the correct methodology as indicated in the Work Instructions/SOPs
check adhesion of roof-lining, insulation material, roof-rail etc. of the auto component

perform assembly operation and assemble the safety parts i.e. bearings, shafts etc., electrical semi-precision parts such as electric wire harness, Electronic Control Unit (ECU), automatic lock system, fuel injection system and other similar parts

perform installation of the Oil and Lube systems by placing and fitting the funnel, filters, hose pipes, glands, sockets, suction guns and regulator valves as prescribed in the Work Instructions/ SOPs/Control Plans
carry out sealing of the required areas to prevent any leakage of water/air etc. during the usage of the component
carry out labeling on the auto components specifying the information related to assembly process and quality norms followed
apply appropriate lubricant on the component as per manufacturer's specifications
check and confirm that water, diesel or petrol, brake oil, gear oil, engine oil etc. are filled as per the required volume and type
check the assembled auto components as per the control plan, work instructions for product quality
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
